[center][b]﻿﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ecl5gzA.png[/img]
﻿[b]
Many rings. Many effects.[/b][/b][/center]
[b]


﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rkHX3OF.png[/img]
﻿[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Adds various cosmetic rings to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Abandoned_House]Hat Mouse's shop[/url]﻿.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Ring effects vary from summoning a follower (butterfly, rabbit, fairy and Junimos) to purely visual (rain cloud, petals).[/b][/*]
[*][b]Many rings have idle effects, which occur when the player stands still.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XU0dXfs.png[/img]
﻿

[b]Bunny Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a bunny to follow you around.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Occasionally jumps![/b][/*]
[*][b]25% chance of summoning a baby rabbit instead.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[b]Butterfly Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a random butterfly to follow you around.[/b][/*]
[*][b]If you stand still, the butterfly may randomly land on your head.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[b]Fairy Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a fairy to follow you around.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Gives off light at night / in the dark.[/b][/*]
[*][b]If you stand still, the fairy will wander around.
[/b][/*]
[/list][b][b]Junimo Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a randomly colored Junimo to follow you around.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Occasionally jumps and meeps!
[/b][/*]
[/list][b][b]Petal Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns falling cherry blossoms around you.
[/b][/*]
[/list][b][b]Raindrop Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a rain cloud that follows you around.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[b]Slime Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a randomly colored slime to follow you around.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Rare chance of it being spawned as a prismatic slime.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[b]Dust Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a dust sprite that bounces around.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Occasionally meeps.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[b]Firefly Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a small cluster of fireflies around you.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Give off a more steady light compared to fairy.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[b]Frog Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a frog to follow you around.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Frog currently has two random variations for color.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Occasionally croaks.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[b]Bat Ring
[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawns a random bat of different variations to follow you around.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mTvZy59.png[/img]

Currently not supported, though it will be in the future. Technically it should work in multiplayer, but the ring effects may not appear to the other players.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/3xXM468.png[/img]
﻿﻿﻿
I have not encountered any mods that are incompatible, but always make sure your saves are backed up.

[b]This mod is compatible with Wear More Rings.[/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZHvv8Nw.png[/img]

[b]How do I...[/b]

Get a ring?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]After you've unlocked the Hat Mouse's shop, you'll be able to purchase them.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]
Use multiple of the same ring?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Most rings that summon things will work when wearing multiples of the ring, however it isn't officially supported.[/b][/*]
[*][b]This means if you have problems while wearing two of the same ring, but not when wearing just one, then it isn't a [s]priority issue for me to fix[/s] bug[/b][/*]
[/list][b]
Get rid of my summoned Junimo, etc. ?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Unequipping the ring should despawn any summoned familiar.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]
Change the color of the butterfly / Junimo?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Unequipping and reequipping the ring will cause a new color to be randomly picked.[/b][/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ff00]The Redux does not depend on Json Assets. [/color]

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
